# PolyAlpha: Polymarket Trade Intelligence

> PolyAlpha analyzes 13500 Polymarket markets with real outcomes and real wallet-level winners/losers computed from on-chain trade data.

## Key Pages

- [All Markets](https://polycoach-trade-data.pages.dev/markets/): searchable index of every market.
- [Terminal](https://polycoach-trade-data.pages.dev/): interactive search terminal.

## About

Real Polymarket data: outcomes, dates and volume from public Polymarket sources; winners/losers computed from on-chain Polygon trade records. Not financial advice.
